The project will deliver socio-economic benefits and decent rural employment by (1) empowering community enterprises, (2) sustainable agricultural and livestock practices, (3) pioneering low-impact tourism routes, and (4) addressing local climate vulnerability. Contributions to FAO’s Four Pillars of Decent Work are presented in REF _Ref162358479 \h \* MERGEFORMAT Table 3 08D0C9EA79F9BACE118C8200AA004BA90B02000000080000000E0000005F005200650066003100360032003300350038003400370039000000 . Community level livelihood investments will be based on climate vulnerability assessments and be focused on increasing adaptive capacities for long-term sustainability. The project will support community enterprises in business upskilling and market expansion, which will contribute to local employment. Enhanced agricultural practices and low-impact ecotourism will secure forest-friendly livelihoods and employment, while contributing to cultural preservation of members of ethnic groups.
